messages:
Nora: quick heads-up — dashboard popped: 145M ARR! we did it. planning a little sunset meetup on the roof at 7 for bubbly and sushi. tiny speeches allowed. :sparkles: :tropical_drink:

Ben: yesss. i'll bring the Bluetooth speaker + string lights. playlist suggestions? 'chill victory' or 'sunset hype'? :headphones:

Izzy: congrats team!! shoutout to Kofi and the release crew for no rollback. huge relief. :raised_hands:

Kofi: team effort. also can we get a non-alcoholic sparkling option? and gluten-free sushi rolls?

Reese: mini poll: react with :champagne: for fizzy, :lemon: for mocktails. dietary tags: drop a note. poll closes in 15m.

Ops-bot: Rooftop event created: "145M Sunset Sips" 7–8pm. Capacity 35. Catering note: sushi + small sides. (automated)

Nora: merch update: we have tiny enamel moon pins and new stickers. volunteers to help assemble at 6:15? need 2 people.

Ben: i'll help assemble. will also bring a few LED lanterns. Nora: do we have a sign for 'no parking near loading dock' for the caterer?

Izzy: meme drop: "me who fixed the rate limiter at 3am -> checks ARR at 7am" [link] :joy: :rocket:

Kofi: logistics: if remote folks want swag, drop address in #people-ops and we'll mail.

Reese: vote tally so far — :champagne: 9, :lemon: 3. fizzy wins.

Nora: quick shoutouts in thread pls so i can include names in the toast slide. i'll start: "massive thanks to infra, release, and docs for keeping things smooth."

Ben: "ops and release—silent rockstars."

Izzy: "QA night owls who found the edge-case."

Kofi: "vendor team for same-day catering save."

Nora: perfect. see you at 7. tiny reminder: bring a sweater, rooftop gets chilly. :jack_o_lantern:
